citations.evidence: CDR occurs during the final design phase (Phase C)... As a result of successful completion of the CDR, the build-to baseline, production, and verification plans are approved.

question: Combine Table 2.2-1 and the SIR row of Table 6.7-1: what work does Phase D perform and when must SIR occur relative to that phase?

claims.text: Phase D performs system assembly, integration, and test, including launch and transition to use. The System Integration Review (SIR) must occur at the end of the final design phase (Phase C) and before Phase D begins.

citations.evidence: Phase D: To assemble and integrate the system (hardware, software, and humans), meanwhile developing confidence that it is able to meet the system requirements. Launch and prepare for operations. Perform system end product implementation, assembly, integration and test, and transition to use.
System Integration Review (SIR): SIR occurs at the end of the final design phase (Phase C) and before the systems assembly, integration, and test phase (Phase D) begins.
